paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 5.5 as of September 11, 2026, with a change of -0.54% from the prior close and -27.63% over a window of 21 sessions.

Recent news headlines include a proposal by the largest Fermi shareholder group to hire an independent bank to review sale or recap options and a formal proposal by Toby R. Neugebauer for an independent strategic review of extraordinary transactions. News sources include Stock Titan, MarketBeat, FinanzNachrichten.de, and MarketScreener.

There have been 25 total filings, including 3 Form 4 filings, and 7 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include a PX14A6G form filed on September 11, 2026, and an 8-K form filed on August 31, 2026, which scheduled the first annual meeting of stockholders for October 30, 2026.
